dataList.title: 오프닝
dataList.description: 로딩 직후 오프닝 연출(S1001B) 재생 처리용 숨겨진 퀘스트

dataList.title: Explore the Surroundings
dataList.description: We've arrived at a place called Grand Magasin Sisyphe. Where could Meursault be...? Let's first look around and get our bearings.

dataList.title: Return to the Restroom
dataList.description: We ran into Kromer's older sister at Grand Magasin Sisyphe. We should return to the restroom and regroup first.

dataList.title: In Search of Meursault
dataList.description: Meursault seems to be somewhere in the department store. We saw carpeting on the floor, with clothes displayed in the front. We should explore the department store and find the place where clothes are on display.
It seems something is hidden here.

dataList.title: In Search of Meursault (2)
dataList.description: Meursault seems to be somewhere nearby. We should look for him.

dataList.title: Meursault's Suggestion
dataList.description:
Decide whether to accept Meursault's suggestion.
→ Accepting begins the hunting quest; if deferred, this quest can be received again from the Casualwear Hall employee.

dataList.title: Show the Mannequins to the Exit
dataList.description: To get Meursault back, we need to "help the Mannequins to the exit"—three of them, in total. Kill them and report back to Mimosa, who seems to be the proprietor of the store.

dataList.title: Explore Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.description: Meursault explained what he knows about Grand Magasin Sisyphe. I didn't follow all of it, but one thing is clear: there doesn't seem to be a normal way out. Let's keep exploring.

dataList.title: Explore Grand Magasin Sisyphe (2)
dataList.description: We met a guy named Dubois. Like us, he doesn't seem to have been here long. Let's keep searching the department store for a way upstairs.

dataList.title: Browse the Clothing Display
dataList.description: We've reached a Contemporary Hall. The employee doesn't seem interested in talking. We may as well look through the clothes on display.

dataList.title: Fend off the Hostile Noir Employee
Head to the Rouges' Store
dataList.description: A Noir employee told us about Golden Resin. Next, let's check Le Rouge's Contemporary store on the upper side.

steps.goalDescription1: Go to Le Rouge's Contemporary Store

dataList.title: Find a Huge Needle
dataList.description: Quillian at Le Rouge's Contemporary Store asked us to bring back a huge needle. Find the Mannequin carrying it, take the needle, and return to Quillian.

steps.goalDescription1: Retrieve the Huge Needle and Return to Quillian

dataList.title: Go Shopping for Clothes
dataList.description: We need to build up a purchase record before we can access the upper floor. Buy some clothes from Quillian, then keep looking for a way upstairs.

dataList.title: To the Escalator
dataList.description: We've found an escalator leading to the next floor. Dubois is here too. Let's talk to him before heading up.

dataList.title: Take the Escalator
dataList.description: The escalator is working. We should finally be able to reach 2F.
